description: Paginated findings for a completed run of either product (contract v2: stable findingId, category, severity, evidence, remediation; Marketing Signal findings also carry a stage). Pass runId for one run, domain for that domain's latest completed run, or neither for the organization's most recent completed run. The response carries a resolved block (runId, projectId, domain, how) naming the run that was read. Best for: triaging by severity, category, or stage. Not for: full detail of one finding (index365_get_finding) or first orientation (index365_get_report first). Common mistake: requesting a huge limit; it is capped at 50, so page with cursor. Example: index365_list_findings({ domain: 'yoursite.com', severity: 'critical' }). Next: index365_get_finding with a findingId for the exact fix.

domain.description: Domain or URL resolved to its project's latest completed run (www. is ignored; any subdomain of a project's domain matches). Alternative to runId; omit both for the latest completed run.

runId.description: Completed run id (omit to resolve by domain, or to the latest completed run)

name: index365_list_findings
title: List findings
